profile.headline: SWE @ Capital One
profile.summary:
I am an alumni from the University of Maryland with over five years of programming experience. I plan to strengthen and broaden my knowledge of Computer Science fields directed toward Software engineering.

Additionally, I am an adamant Chess player who looks forward to Chess puzzles and games to study positional and play patterns. Likewise, I get excited about opportunities where I can solve problems and identify patterns that have real human impact.

I love connecting with new people; give me a shout at rjmartinez422@gmail.com or here on LinkedIn!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
[Cloud Operations Resiliency Engineering (CORE)]
• Built full-stack features for Capital One’s enterprise chaos-testing platform that powers resiliency exercises across all 1,300+ applications, owning the facilitator’s workflow and incident paging pipeline, reducing administrative efforts by 50%
• Engineered a full-stack GenAI feature for Capital One’s enterprise-criticality assessment platform, translating the complex framework criticality scores into a plain-language summary to reduce a 15% delay in executive certification decisions

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
[Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX)]
• Developing a graphical neural network model to predict relationships between API endpoints, generate test data, detect misconfigurations, and analyze the activity of assets within an API gateway environment
• Analyzing large-scale API network graphs to identify patterns in endpoint usage, utilizing graph algorithms and machine learning techniques to uncover trends and inform predictive modeling
• Collaborating in a team of four interns to design and implement the GNN-based solution, participating in weekly meetings to align on project milestones, address technical challenges, and foster effective teamwork and
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · Software Industry · Docker · Software Infrastructure · Neural Networks

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
[Subscribe & Save (SnS) Team] - amazon.com/Subscribe/b?node=5856181011
• Reorganized the system design of the Subscribe & Save webpage to enable dynamic widget placement, enhancing customer satisfaction and product visibility, using AWS, Java Spring Framework, and internal query tools
• Implemented routing modifications across several Subscribe & Save webpages to improve the flow of navigation and user experience, utilizing Java Spring Boot Framework and XML configuration files
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define and prioritize feature requests, conducted code reviews, utilized data analytics to optimize performance, and contributed to agile development processes
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Spring Framework · Full-Stack Development · Git · Systems Design

company.name: University of Maryland Office of Multi-ethnic Student Education

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description:
• Led front-end development of the College Success Scholars (CSS) program’s traffic log to handle 7000+ yearly form submissions using the student’s ID card to verify correct information and demonstrate growth to the program’s sponsors
• Reorganized back-end for storing data on tutoring analytics to streamline professional support and increase scalability for the program’s future growth using JavaScript, Google Sheets, and Google’s App Script
• Presented weekly meetings with colleagues and the program’s executive department to discuss and share ideas, flowcharts, and upcoming features to increase transparency between departments

positions.title: Executive Board Leader
positions.description:
• Provided ongoing support for Black and Latino male students' personal lives, education, and careers by maintaining high standards of the College Success Scholars (CSS) program and assisting in tutoring services, study groups, and review sessions to ensure the 150+ students were engaged and productive in their activities
• Mentored 4 first-year underrepresented minority computer science students for an academic year to increase their encouragement for programming and to increase diversity in computer science
• Represented the College Success Scholars (CSS) at parent meetings and prospective student panels involving hundreds of participants

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: • Advised and provided documentation to the College Success Scholars (CSS) accountability program, through receptionist work, sessions with tutors, and sign-in sheets involving 150+ students to supply membership analytics for the program

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.locationName: College Park, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Assisted incoming Computer Science students with concepts and logistics behind Java programming using personalized teaching techniques to ensure that each recipient had a good understanding of the given subject
• Introduced concepts and visual representations of code from previous lectures and exercises to allow tutees to think about their code more conceptually
